article.headline: McGriff scores 16 as UNC Wilmington knocks off North Carolina A&T 83-59
article.description: — Khamari McGriff's 16 points off of the bench led UNC Wilmington to an 83-59 victory over N.C. A&T on Thursday night.
article.linkText: McGriff scores 16 as UNC Wilmington knocks off North Carolina A&T 83-59
article.story: GREENSBORO, N.C. -- — Khamari McGriff's 16 points off of the bench led UNC Wilmington to an 83-59 victory over N.C. A&T on Thursday night. McGriff shot 8 of 11 from the field for the Seahawks (17-5, 7-2 Coastal Athletic Association). Sean Moore scored 15 points while shooting 6 for 12, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc and added 12 rebounds. Bo Montgomery finished 7 of 10 from the field to finish with 15 points. Jahnathan Lamothe led the way for the Aggies (4-19, 0-10) with 20 points and four assists. N.C. A&T also got 16 points, six rebounds and four assists from Nikolaos Chitikoudis. The loss is the ninth in a row for the Aggies. UNC Wilmington led 42-25 at halftime, with Nolan Hodge racking up 10 points. UNC Wilmington extended its lead to 72-46 during the second half, fueled by a 7-0 scoring run. Moore scored a team-high 12 points in the second half. Up next for UNC Wilmington is a matchup Saturday with Stony Brook at home. N.C. A&T visits Charleston on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
